entity.name: Darwing John Pérez Aranguren
entity.description: Independent developer based in Colombia, working with AI coding tools under verification gates. Maintains Q-Crypto Evolve, an Apache-2.0 post-quantum cryptography project, and publishes its limits and open incidents openly.

projects.name: Q-Crypto Evolve
projects.description: Open lab for post-quantum cryptography engineering: a TLS 1.3 bridge with an external PSK over OpenSSL 3.5 (X25519MLKEM768, SecP384r1MLKEM1024) via ctypes, HSM integration through PKCS#11 (tested with SoftHSM), and an ETSI GS QKD 014 client and test KME. All code, tests and documentation were written by an AI (Claude) under verification gates: 846 tests (4 optional), 434 mutants, a log of 35 incidents with their faults, and a reproducible review package. No human has reviewed it yet; the human sign-offs the method requires (G5/G6) are pending. The funding would pay for one independent security review of the three components, whose report would be published.

channels.description: Bank account of the entity (individual, Colombia); details provided on request after acceptance.

plans.name: Independent security review (one-time)
plans.description: One independent white-box security review of the TLS 1.3 PSK bridge, the PKCS#11/HSM integration and the ETSI 014 client, with a published report bound to the reviewed version. Quotes received from independent firms are in the range of 9,000 to 13,650 EUR.
